item.title: Shrews exhibit reversible size changes in their skulls and noses to get through the winter
item.description: Scientists had previously observed that some species of shrews undergo a form of biological plasticity in which their bodies, skulls, brains and some organs shrink in the winter, then regrow in the spring.
